address: Le Dream Boutique Hotel, 139 Jalan Pintal Tali, George Town, 10100, Malaysia
bio: This casual neighbourhood dining spot started out as a steakhouse, but switched to serving European cuisine with Asian influences. Their signature kataifi prawn is tiger prawn wrapped in crispy noodles, fried and served in a prawn bisque sauce. Meat lovers should check out the Australian Wagyu ribeye which is cooked to perfection on a charcoal grill. It comes with a range of condiments but the wasabi works best. Wine is available by the bottle only....
